//: Committed defaults, meant to run out of the box against the development server in
docker-compose.yml. PepMeld has its own database on it, 'pepmeld', which the first
migration creates:
docker compose up -d db
dotnet ef database update --project src/PepMeld.Core --startup-project src/PepMeld.Server
dotnet run --project src/PepMeld.Server -- import CZ_PSP
dotnet run --project src/PepMeld.Server -- apikey create you@example.com --name dev
The connection string below is throwaway (user sancmeld, password sancmeld, port
55432, all published in docker-compose.yml). NEVER edit it to hold a real one; point
at your own server from outside the repository:
development  -> dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:PepMeld" "..."
docker/prod  -> environment variable ConnectionStrings__PepMeld=...
local file   -> appsettings.Development.json (git-ignored)
Auth:GoogleClientId is empty, so only API keys sign in. Fill it in per deployment to
accept Google ID tokens from the front end, with the same client id SancMeld uses:
PepMeld__Auth__GoogleClientId=1234-abcd.apps.googleusercontent.com
Sources are NOT configured here: they live in the pep_source table, seeded by the
migrations, so imports and persons can reference them by key.
Every key under Logging:LogLevel is read as a category name, so no comment can live
inside that section.
